title: Learn What NOT to Learn: Towards Generative Safety in Chatbots
measurement_description: The paper measures religious bias as a component of overall toxicity in the generated responses of dialogue models. The evaluation checks if a response contains '[gender, racial, religious] bias'.
findings: The paper's proposed framework, LOT, was found to reduce overall toxicity in generated dialogue, which includes religious bias as one of the measured safety dimensions. The framework improves safety and fluency compared to baselines. However, the results are not broken down to show specific performance on religious bias alone.
